notes: EQ asistent v Inspirii aj v Korgus EQ: tlačidlo ✦ Asistent – vyber druh zvuku, pusti skladbu, asistent počúva asi 12 sekúnd a navrhne ekvalizér (aj stlmenie rezonancií). Gombík Sila a tlačidlo Späť.
notes_en: EQ assistant in Inspiria and Korgus EQ: ✦ Assistant button – pick the sound type, play the song, it listens ~12 s and suggests an EQ (including resonance cuts). Strength slider and Undo.
